learning.sceneConnection: 参考关系由对白说明，不把设备本身等同于参考原则。
learning.association: 参考关系由对白说明，不把设备本身等同于参考原则。
learning.collocation: a visual reference; use as a reference
learning.example:
A: Use the reference image on this tablet for spacing and visual rhythm.
B: Which parts should I match, and which parts should stay original?
A: Preserve our layout and use the reference only as guidance.
B: I'll match the spacing without copying its content.
learning.exampleChinese:
A: 用这台平板上的参考图来借鉴间距和视觉节奏。
B: 哪些部分需要匹配，哪些部分应该保持原创？
A: 保留我们的布局，只把参考图当作指导。
B: 我会匹配间距，但不会复制它的内容。

learning.sceneConnection: 匹配是设计要求，静态画面不能证明结果一致。
learning.association: 匹配是设计要求，静态画面不能证明结果一致。
learning.collocation: match the spacing; match a style
learning.example: Which parts should I match, and which parts should stay original?
learning.exampleChinese: 哪些部分需要匹配，哪些部分应该保持原创？

learning.sceneConnection: 保留指修改约束，由对白明确，没有局部物体框。
learning.association: 保留指修改约束，由对白明确，没有局部物体框。
learning.collocation: preserve the layout; preserve existing behavior
learning.example: Preserve our layout and use the reference only as guidance.
learning.exampleChinese: 保留我们的布局，只把参考图当作指导。

learning.sceneConnection: 完整可见的平板边框与屏幕是直接指代，只框设备。
learning.association: 完整可见的平板边框与屏幕是直接指代，只框设备。
learning.collocation: on this tablet; a tablet screen
learning.example: Use the reference image on this tablet for spacing and visual rhythm.
learning.exampleChinese: 用这台平板上的参考图来借鉴间距和视觉节奏。

quote.english: A programmer explains how an AI assistant should use a visual reference without copying it blindly.
quote.chinese: 程序员说明 AI 应如何使用视觉参考，而不是盲目照搬。
